_comment: SECRETS ARE NOT SET HERE (#1232, #1428). This file is committed to git and shown in the Railway dashboard, so the keeper signing keys (KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY, KEEPER_SECRET_KEY), the admin token (ADMIN_API_TOKEN) and the optional PYTH_API_KEY are dashboard-only: add them under the service Variables tab and mark each one Sealed (README.md, Deployment > Railway). CI's manifest-secrets job fails if any of them is assigned under variables. Railway ignores this key.
